course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Compare advantages and disadvantages with å ena sidan and å andra sidan.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing whether living in a city or smaller town better fits everyday needs.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Presenting two sides of a practical choice before stating a preference.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik compare city life and a smaller town for housing, transport, services, and social life.

main_focus.name: balanced contrast with å ena sidan and å andra sidan
main_focus.description: Use paired contrast phrases to present advantages and disadvantages before a decision.
model_examples: Å ena sidan finns det fler jobb i staden.
Å andra sidan är hyran ofta lägre i en mindre stad.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use the paired contrast structure 2-3 times and add one clear preference statement.

allowed_supporting_grammar: opinion frames with jag tycker att
relative clauses with som for simple descriptions

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical living-choice vocabulary and keep the comparison grounded in daily life.

dialogue_shape.opening: The choice between two living situations is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare advantages and disadvantages, using balanced contrast language.
dialogue_shape.ending: They state which option fits better and why.

target_complexity.repetition: The contrast should be organized but conversational, not an essay outline.

focus: the main advantages and disadvantages of the two options
which factor matters most in the comparison
the preferred option and the reason for it

sentence_focus: one sentence with å ena sidan
one sentence with å andra sidan
one sentence saying which factor weighs most
